purpose: Presentation-only layout and legibility changes, no experiments rerun

comparison.method: Equal-width vector PDF crops with symmetric artwork bounds, so each panel is centered over its count and caption.

icl.method: Graphic-only SVG-to-PDF export with outlined text, preserving the visible adapted figure and removing hidden article text outside the crop
icl.source_credit: Dong et al. (2024), retained in the numbered caption

gradcam.method: Same selected canonical synthetic V1 case and recorded heatmap. Original 896 by 896 grayscale tracing replaces the 224-pixel model-display underlay. The heatmap is embedded from its native canonical crop and overlaid in the same normalized full-image coordinates. Three-panel format and vector titles are preserved.

pipeline_palette.scope: Embedded CNN and VLM/ICL test-sample headers now match HUCA and evaluation. Text and token colors are retained for contrast.
